sentences.text: The ABC islands are the three western-most islands of the Leeward Antilles in the Caribbean Sea that lie north of Falcón State , Venezuela .	Leeward Antilles	Leeward Antilles	Caribbean Sea	Caribbean Sea	Falcón State	Falcón State	Venezuela	Venezuela
From west to east they are , in order Aruba , Curaçao , and Bonaire .	Aruba	Aruba	Curaçao	Curaçao	Bonaire	Bonaire

All three islands are part of the Kingdom of the Netherlands , although they remain outside the European Union .	Kingdom of the Netherlands	Kingdom of the Netherlands	European Union	European Union	Netherlands	Netherlands

Aruba and Curaçao are autonomous , self-governing constituent countries of the Kingdom of the Netherlands , while Bonaire is a special municipality of the Netherlands proper .
